subject: SIG questionnaire initiation + clarifying questions (SOC 2 / HIPAA / GDPR)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sat, 31 Jul 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation + clarifying questions (SOC 2 / HIPAA / GDPR)

Hi Dana —

Great to meet earlier today — thanks for the time and for walking through Acme Health's integration goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the security/compliance items we discussed: 

1) Recap (what we confirmed on the call)
- Redwood will be processing PHI for specified workflows (care-coordination labels) under a BAA.
- You’re primarily concerned with SOC 2 attestation, HIPAA controls (BAA), and GDPR data residency/DSR support.
- Procurement and security will run a SIG/CAIQ-style questionnaire for vendor assessment.

2) Immediate asks from your side
- Please confirm the security contact(s) who should receive the SIG initiation (you mentioned dana.liu and procurement@acmehealth.com).
- Any internal timeline constraints for completing the questionnaire?

3) Info I'm attaching/sending now
- Attached: Redwood_SIG_Initiation.pdf (starter packet for the SIG + requested contact list)
- Attached: Redwood_SOC2_Snapshot_2026.pdf (summary copy of our latest SOC 2 attestation highlights; full report available under NDA)

4) Clarifying questions we have to make the SIG process quicker
- Which SIG template are you using? (You mentioned a template in XLSX during the call.) If you can share that, we’ll pre-fill sections we control.
- For HIPAA: do you need the full BAA executed before we start the SIG or is a signed BAA acceptable after we provide the initial answers?
- Data residency: which region(s) must data remain within for your eval (US-only, specific states, or EU)?
- Subprocessors: are there particular vendors you require us to disclose immediately (e.g., for telemetry, logging)?

Proposed next steps:
- I’ll initiate the SIG packet and pre-fill vendor-side answers where possible once you share your template.
- Marissa (cc'd) will take the technical sections (network, encryption, logging). Rafael (cc'd) is on compliance and can handle contract-level questions and SOC 2 access.
- Aim to return a first-pass completed SIG within 5 business days after we receive your template.

If that timeline works, please reply with the template and confirm security recipients. Happy to loop in procurement contacts as needed.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation + clarifying questions (SOC 2 / HIPAA / GDPR)

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the clear recap. A couple quick items: 

- Confirmed recipients: please include security@acmehealth.com and procurement@acmehealth.com on the SIG packet. I will be the primary security reviewer but security@ will be looped for final sign-off.
- Template: attaching our Acme_SIG_Questionnaire_Template.xlsx — it’s our standard vendor questionnaire (SIG-lite with some custom Acme addenda).
- SOC 2: We will need a SOC 2 Type II report for the most recent 12-month period. An NDA is fine if needed to share the full report; snapshots are helpful for preliminary review.
- Encryption: please confirm whether data-at-rest encryption is enabled by default and whether customer-managed keys (CMKs via KMS/HSM) are supported.
- Data retention: what is Redwood’s default retention for logs and request payloads, and can that be adjusted per contract?
- Timeline: we are targeting vendor assessments to finish in two weeks for the initial shortlist. Faster is better but two weeks is our procurement target.

One other note — for HIPAA/BAA: procurement generally requires an executed BAA before production access but is OK starting the questionnaire before the BAA is fully executed.

Thanks,
Dana
Senior Security Manager, Acme Health
Dana.Liu@acmehealth.com

Attachment: Acme_SIG_Questionnaire_Template.xlsx
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Aug 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation + clarifying questions (SOC 2 / HIPAA / GDPR)

Hi Dana —

Thanks — received the template (thanks for attaching). Quick answers inline to help triage the SIG: 

- SOC 2 Type II: We can provide SOC 2 Type II report access under NDA. The attached SOC2 snapshot is our high-level summary; if you share an NDA link or DocuSign, we’ll provide the full report to security@acmehealth.com.

- Encryption (data-at-rest): Yes — data at rest is encrypted by default using AES-256. We support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and HSM integrations for private deployments (we can document the supported KMS key ARNs/flows in the SIG).

- Data retention: Default retention for request payloads and logs is 90 days. We can offer customized retention windows as a contractual option (30/90/365 days) depending on the Dedicated/Private plan and contractual terms.

- Subprocessors: We maintain a public subprocessors list; primary subprocessors include: AWS (compute/storage), Sumo Logic (logs/monitoring), and Sentry (error-tracking). We will include an up-to-date subprocessors section in our SIG response.

Next steps from our side: 
- I’m attaching the pre-filled SIG initiation packet (Redwood_SIG_Initiation.pdf) with the contact list updated to include security@acmehealth.com and procurement@acmehealth.com.
- Marissa will handle network, encryption, and logging sections. Rafael will manage legal/contractual and SOC 2 follow-up items (NDA/DocuSign).
- We’ll aim to return the completed XLSX with vendor answers and supporting attachments within 3 business days. If you need a faster turnaround, let us know and we’ll prioritize.

Would you like us to upload the completed XLSX to a shared Drive link or send back via email? We can also create a HubSpot folder for the deal if that’s easier.

Best,
Camila
